withMirrors.label: Chisel-Light Mirror
withMirrors.reason: His Normal and Charged Attacks are his damage, dealt while his Chisel-Light Mirrors are up, which makes them Dendro.

debateStacks.label: Constellation 2 stacks
debateStacks.reason: Constellation 2 stacks that build up during the fight.

mirrorsConsumed.label: Dendro bonus from the mirrors his Burst makes
mirrorsConsumed.reason: With Constellation 6 his Burst makes three mirrors about 2 seconds after it is cast, which gives him a Dendro DMG Bonus for 15 seconds; most of the Burst's own hits land before it and it runs out before his next Burst, so it covers only part of his main talents.
